question: Choose the option that contains the homonym of the highlighted word in the given sentence.**Please make sure to write your full home address**, including the apartment number and zip code, on the top of the application form.

options.text: After living in the city for ten years, Sarah had to notify the post office that her permanent address was changing to a rural farmhouse.
The delivery driver called me because he was having trouble finding my address on the GPS due to the new construction in the neighborhood.
Millions of people tuned in to watch the president’s televised address regarding the new economic policies.
The celebrity requested that her residential address be kept private and removed from all public search directories for security reasons.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Millions of people tuned in to watch the president’s televised address regarding the new economic policies."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"address"** in the given sentence refers to a person's location or residence where they can be reached, such as a home address. (पता)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Please write your home address clearly on the envelope.
 
 
 
• The word **"address"** in Option 3 refers to a formal speech or statement delivered to an audience, often on an important occasion or topic. (भाषण)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The principal’s address during the graduation ceremony inspired the students.
 
 
 
• These two meanings of the word "address" make it a homonym, as they are spelled and pronounced the same but have different meanings.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "After living in the city for ten years, Sarah had to notify the post office that her permanent address was changing to a rural farmhouse." 
 (पता): This refers to a person's location or residence. It is the same meaning as the original usage of "address" in the question and does not contain a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** My permanent address is listed on my ID card.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The delivery driver called me because he was having trouble finding my address on the GPS due to the new construction in the neighborhood." 
 (पता): Again, this refers to a person's location or residence, the same as in the question, and does not involve a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** The package was delivered to the wrong address.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The celebrity requested that her residential address be kept private and removed from all public search directories for security reasons."
 (पता): This refers to the location where someone resides, consistent with the original meaning in the question, and does not involve a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** Due to privacy concerns, her home address is confidential.
